title: Apexspace bus platforms
description: A pure-black product band: a light uppercase heading left, a paragraph and a small mono badge right, then three outlined product cards sharing hairlines with + crosshairs at the corners, and a centred mono link with a yellow underline. On phones the cards become a swipe track (one card with the next peeking), with arrow buttons and diamond name tabs that follow the scroll.
notes: uses the card surface (pure black in the faithful theme) for the whole band
phones and tablets (below 1024px): scroll-snap track; the arrows and tabs need JavaScript (hydrate: visible), swiping works without it
three cards fill the desktop row; more than three wrap onto a new row
name: apexspace-platforms
